name: Generate images of tensor
summary: Generates PNGs of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of each DTI (FA, MD, AD, RD) and, when present, DKI (GA, AK, MK, RK) map with FSL slicer, for quick QA of a tensor fit.
description: Runs FSL slicer -a on every map in the tensor datatype and writes one PNG per map to raw/. Kurtosis maps are rendered only when GA is present in the input. Use it to check a DTI/DKI fit or make figures; it does not modify the data.

inputs.description: Tensor datatype with FA, MD, RD and AD maps, plus optional kurtosis maps (GA, AK, MK, RK).

outputs.description: Directory with one PNG per tensor map (fa.png, md.png, ad.png, rd.png and, for DKI, ga.png, mk.png, ak.png, rk.png).
